# BioPharm World

> > BioPharm World provides sanitary process equipment, cleanroom supplies, and bioprocess solutions for biopharmaceutical and laboratory applications.

Based in Maryland, BioPharm World specializes in single-use products, sanitary fittings, and laboratory equipment for the biopharmaceutical industry. The company represents leading brands including Saint-Gobain and C-Flex TPE technologies.

## Key Topics

- Cleanroom supplies
- Sanitary fittings and process equipment
- Single-use bioprocessing products
- Biopharmaceutical manufacturing
- Laboratory equipment and instrumentation
- Lab furniture and cleanroom design
- Bioprocess solutions
- Sanitary process expertise
- Saint-Gobain products
- C-Flex TPE tubing
- GMP compliance equipment
- Sterile processing systems
